definitions.explanation: A pattern of stripes running horizontally (left to right). Common in clothing and fabric design.

examples.japanese: {横縞|よこじま}のTシャツが{好|す}きだ。
{赤|あか}と{白|しろ}の{横縞|よこじま}はフランスっぽい{雰囲気|ふんいき}がある。
examples.english: Red and white horizontal stripes have a French feel.

examples.japanese: {横縞|よこじま}の{模様|もよう}は{体|からだ}を{横|よこ}に{広|ひろ}く{見|み}せると{言|い}われている。
examples.english: Horizontal stripe patterns are said to make the body look wider.

notes: The opposite pattern is {縦縞|たてじま} (vertical stripes). Also called ボーダー in Japanese fashion terminology (from the English 'border'), especially for casual clothing like T-shirts. The combination {横縞|よこじま}のボーダーシャツ is commonly used in everyday conversation.
